visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person in a white suit stands on a raised platform inside a massive domed stadium with bright overhead spotlights. A large group of dancers dressed in red shirts and khaki pants performs synchronized movements on the green artificial turf below. The scene is captured from a wide, medium-long shot perspective highlighting the expansive architecture. (2) The focus shifts to large electronic display screens above the field which show video clips of a baseball player in a black and yellow uniform hitting balls and celebrating with teammates. The stadium lighting is dimmed, and many people in the audience are visible holding up small, glowing handheld light sticks. (3) A nighttime shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper is shown, with a specific message lit up on its LED side. Back in the stadium, bright pyrotechnic sparks and smoke erupt from the stage area, illuminating the crowd. The camera pans across the audience who are waving in unison. (4) Close-up shot of a man in a white suit with a decorative red sash across his chest. His eyes are glistening with moisture, and he has a somber, emotional facial expression. He raises his hand to wipe his eye while standing behind a microphone. In the background, other figures in dark clothing look on. (5) The video transitions to a solid black screen with large white text and a numerical symbol displayed in a stylized font in the center. The camera remains static for several seconds as the text is presented before the final fade-out.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male voice delivering an impassioned speech with high vocal arousal, set against a constant, low-frequency roar of a massive stadium crowd. A high-tempo pop-rock track with driving electric guitar and drums begins, creating a heroic and emotional atmosphere. (2) A sharp, percussive 'crack' sound occurs repeatedly, mirroring the sound of a ball being hit, followed by synchronized rhythmic chanting from the crowd. The male voice transitions into singing, with a soaring pitch variability and high intensity, blending with the upbeat musical arrangement. (3) Sudden, loud booming sounds with a wide spectral bandwidth signify pyrotechnics, creating a dramatic dynamic peak. The music swells with added synthesizers and sustained guitar notes while the cheering intensifies into a continuous wall of sound. (4) The male singer's voice becomes significantly softer, adopting a breathy and strained tone that conveys high emotional vulnerability. The background music ducks slightly in volume, emphasizing the vocal's melodic contour and strategic pauses, though the indoor stadium ambience remains clearly audible. (5) The performance concludes with a grand crescendo involving heavy percussion and a final, long-sustaining musical chord. This is followed by an explosion of loud, dense applause and cheering from the audience before the audio track fades into a brief, low-energy room tone and then total silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Achievement Highlights -> Emotional Climax -> Final Farewell
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a commemorative tribute to legendary Taiwanese baseball player Lin Chih-Sheng (#31) during his retirement ceremony. It combines live concert performance, career highlights, and emotional personal moments to evoke nostalgia and respect among fans while celebrating his long-standing contribution to the sport.
